allowed: The official Jin et al. Neural-Predictor code completed numerical-evaluation and training smoke tests after two documented Windows/artifact compatibility repairs.
The complete published wrapper ran, but its Neural Predictor metrics did not exactly match the repository's separately published CSV.
V9 generated a frozen 240-trajectory five-link identification bank using Full-LQR without wind truth as a training or runtime input.
Twenty-four preregistered Neural Predictor configurations were evaluated on a whole-trajectory validation split.
The diagnostic best model improved torque RMSE but did not beat the best simple estimator on force RMSE, so the preregistered predictor gate failed.
NP-MPC implementation, Development evaluation, SATC comparison, and the inherited one-shot Holdout were not executed.
The highest validated project claim remains V5_SELF_OVERALL_HOLDOUT_WIN.
forbidden: Paper and SATC have a validated performance trade-off
